title: BeerSmith Batch Weekly Fermentation Days Trend
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beersmith:batch ferment_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(ferment_days) as avg_duration, max(ferment_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst fermentation days for BeerSmith batch events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture ferment_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average fermentation days with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews whether BeerSmith batch tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
